content.title: Fertilizer stocks under pressure as U.S. lifts Belarus potash sanctions
content.summary: Shares of Mosaic (MOS), Nutrien (NTR), CF Industries (CF), and Intrepid Potash (IPI) are under pressure on Monday after the U.S. announced it would remove sanctions on Belarusian potash fertilizers. According to Bloomberg, special envoy John Coale said President Trump ordered the sanctions lifted, effective immediately. More restrictions might be eased as U.S.-Belarus relations normalize, Coale added. Announcement follows Trump’s push to rebuild ties with Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenk
